from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """A paper in the provided collection, capturing its identity and references to other collection papers."""
    title: str = Field(description="The full title of this specific paper")
    references_collection_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of OTHER papers in the collection that this paper cites")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper]
